html:
LingBot-Depth (Robbyant, 2026): metric depth completion from an image plus an incomplete or noisy metric depth map (RGB-D camera, LiDAR), and a depth-completion variant (dc). Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Speed and memory not measured for: lingbot-depth, lingbot-depth-dc.

Details
  • Paper: Masked Depth Modeling for Spatial Perception, arXiv, 2026-01-25
  • Original code: https://github.com/robbyant/lingbot-depth at f3a237e
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/robbyant/lingbot-depth/blob/main/LICENSE and the Hugging Face model cards (license: apache-2.0)
  • Training data: Large-scale real and synthetic RGB-D data with masked depth modelling per the tech report
  • Options: resolution_level = 9 (0 to 9)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused
  • Variants: lingbot-depth, lingbot-depth-dc
  • Outputs: depth, mask; kind: metric
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 14)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): lingbot-depth 3000x4000 (1.7 GiB peak allocated, 2.1 reserved); lingbot-depth-dc 3000x4000 (1.7 GiB peak allocated, 2.1 reserved)

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.005 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 1.5 % and p99 <= 5 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output depth).

Limitations

  • The depth map is required: call the model with prompt_depth= a metric map in metres (any size, holes as 0 / NaN / inf). Its holes change the ViT's token count, so the kernels mode runs the ViT per image. Export keeps every depth token (masked) and has a fixed size.
